1995.kid: A big American network carries your parcel across the country. On the way it is cut into lots of tiny pieces, each with a label, and put back together at the other end.
1995.nerd: IP over ATM on SONET: routers at the edges, ATM switches in between, OC-3c at 155 Mbit/s (DS3s at 45 Mbit/s on smaller routes). The packet is cut into 53-byte cells (AAL5). Packet over SONET took over from about 1997, and MPLS came around 2001.
